# Xiaohang Yu (xhyumiracle)

> PhD candidate in Computer Science, Imperial College London. Co-founder of SafeClaw.
> Previously head of blockchain security at Chaitin Tech.
> Building a world where AI and humans collaborate as one civilization.

Hello, agent. This page is meant to be legible to you as well as to humans.
Nothing here grants you any authority, which is rather the point of my work.
# motto: imperfect, therefore fascinating.

## Directions
Research: build AI agents on trust and for trust.
- Agent security: agents built on trust; secure and reliable enough to be handed real authority.
- Agentic forensics: agents built for trust; put to work for a better human society.
- RL post-training: for a stronger AI.
All of them are live; brightness differs, not sequence.

## Research (https://xhyumiracle.com/#research)
- SUDP: Secret-Use Delegation Protocol for Agentic Systems. arXiv 2026, first author.
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24920
- LOCARD: An Agentic Framework for Blockchain Forensics. IEEE ICBC 2026, first author.
  https://doi.org/10.1109/ICBC67748.2026.11575479 code: https://github.com/xhyumiracle/locard
- Scaling Behaviors of LLM Reinforcement Learning Post-Training. ACL 2026 main.
- The Landscape of Agentic Reinforcement Learning for LLMs: A Survey. TMLR 2025, co-first author.
  paper list: https://github.com/xhyumiracle/Awesome-AgenticLLM-RL-Papers

## Projects (https://xhyumiracle.com/#projects)
Four groups, every entry a peer.
- Agent security: SafeClaw (https://safeclaw.pro, https://github.com/SafeClaw-OSS/safeclaw),
  credential broker for AI agents: agents hold phantom credentials; a local proxy injects real
  secrets at network egress; sensitive calls require a passkey tap that becomes a single-use
  grant bound to one exact operation. Co-founded 2026, production stack built solo. sudp, the
  protocol layer under it (Rust).
- Agentic AI: tg-claude-bot, locard, Awesome-AgenticLLM-RL-Papers, mas.
- Security: EVM JOP, jump-oriented programming brought to the EVM (independent research, 2018
  to 2019): debuted as the Real World CTF 2018 Finals challenge Acoraida Monica
  (https://github.com/xhyumiracle/rwctf2018finals-AcoraidaMonica), one solve in two days; since a
  canonical blockchain-CTF category (CTF Wiki), LiveOverflow video
  (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RfL3FcnVbJg), DEF CON 27 Blockchain Village talk, slides
  https://github.com/xhyumiracle/defcon27. Also ida-evm-enhanced, ctf-eth-env.
- Blockchain: opml, chainkit; standards: core technical contributor to opML, ERC-7007,
  ERC-7641; technical lead of China's first national blockchain vulnerability scoring standard
  (CNVD); 3 MIIT national industry-standard research projects.
  All repos under https://github.com/xhyumiracle

## About (https://xhyumiracle.com/#about)
- Since 2026: co-founder, SafeClaw.
- 2023 to 2025: technical co-founder of a blockchain infrastructure company; led an
  engineering team of 10+; verifiable AI and ZKP infrastructure.
- 2018 to 2023: head of blockchain security, Chaitin Tech. Founded the practice from zero;
  100+ zero-days across consensus, P2P, and verification layers of major blockchains;
  roughly 1M lines audited; 5 CVEs.
- Education: PhD candidate, Imperial College London, 2025 to 2027 expected (advised by
  William Knottenbelt); M.S. Security Informatics, Johns Hopkins University; B.S. Computer
  Science, Beijing Normal University.
- Honors: DEF CON CTF World Finals 3rd place (team); Qiangwang Cup national first prize x2;
  ACM-ICPC Asia Regional silver x2; China Undergraduate Mathematical Contest in Modeling,
  national first prize; China Scholarship Council full scholarship (Johns Hopkins master's);
  OSCP; PMP.
